description: This file defines the 'ProcessManager' for managing MCP server processes, including starting, connecting, monitoring, executing setup, health checks, stopping, restarting processes, and logging, specifically tailored for local and remote MCP server instances.

classes.name: ProcessManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of MCP server processes, including starting, stopping, connecting to remote servers, monitoring, health checks, and logging.

methods.name: NewProcessManager
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of ProcessManager with specified project directory, template processor, and verbosity flag.

methods.name: StartLocalMCP
methods.description: Starts a local MCP server process using the provided configuration, handling port allocation and command execution.

methods.name: ConnectRemoteMCP
methods.description: Connects to an existing remote MCP server given its configuration, returning a process handle.

methods.name: MonitorProcess
methods.description: Monitors a running MCP process, detects exit, and updates process status accordingly.

methods.name: ExecuteSetupCommands
methods.description: Runs setup commands for configuring an MCP server before startup.

methods.name: ExecuteRunCommand
methods.description: Prepares and returns an exec.Cmd to run the MCP server with processed commands and environment.

methods.name: FindAvailablePort
methods.description: Finds an available network port starting from a specified port number.

methods.name: IsPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is available for use.

methods.name: HealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on the MCP server via a configured command.

methods.name: StopProcess
methods.description: Gracefully stops a running MCP process, falling back to kill if needed.

methods.name: RestartProcess
methods.description: Restarts an MCP process by stopping and then starting it again.

methods.name: IsProcessRunning
methods.description: Checks if the process is still running.

methods.name: GetProcessLogs
methods.description: Returns a reader for the process logs, optionally following or limiting output lines.
